title.en: Home Again: a Rhapsody, with Preface

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource, with Tao Yuanming's own preface; textual notes are omitted, and the rhapsody is set in its four usual sections.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，附陶渊明自序；不录校记，辞分通常的四段。

basis.en: Eastern Jin rhapsody; the author died in 427.
basis.zh: 东晋辞赋，作者卒于 427 年。

note.en: Tao Yuanming's song of going home in 405, after a little more than eighty days as magistrate of Pengze, with his own preface explaining why he left. It is shelved with the prose, keeping its line breaks. Notice the clouds that drift out of the hills without intent, and the birds that, tired of flying, know to come home.
note.zh: 陶渊明 405 年辞去彭泽令（在官八十余日）回乡时所作，附他自己说明去职缘由的序。归入文类，保留原有分行。留意“云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还”。

excerpt.orig: 雲無心以出岫，鳥倦飛而知還。
excerpt.en: The clouds drift out of the hills without intent; the birds, tired of flying, know to come home.
excerpt.zh: 云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还。
